label: megathrust, Andrade substrate
blurb: The first model once more, on an Andrade substrate: its transient creep grows as the cube root of time, the law creep follows in the laboratory, on top of the same steady flow. Such a material has no fastest relaxation time, so it starts to let go at once however early one looks.
